name: What happens after I receive my waterfront property CMA?

mainEntity.name: What happens after I receive my waterfront property CMA?

acceptedAnswer.text: After you receive your waterfront property CMA, you will have a clear understanding of your property's estimated market value based on current conditions and comparable sales. For sellers, the next step involves discussing the findings with your real estate agent to strategize the optimal listing price and marketing plan, considering the unique appeal of your waterfront features. For buyers, it helps inform your offer strategy. This process clarifies realistic expectations and helps you make informed decisions, whether you're aiming to sell, buy, or simply understand your asset's value. Your agent can then guide you through listing agreements or offer preparations.
acceptedAnswer.description: After receiving your CMA, you'll understand your property's market value, which informs your next steps for selling, buying, or refinancing with your agent.
